name: STGT fold 1 drowsiness model
feature_extractor: ML Kit Face Mesh 468 (MediaPipe canonical indices)
mobile_optimization: Exact GELU FlexErf is replaced by the built-in tanh approximation so Android does not need the large Select-TF-Ops runtime.
notes: Android extracts EAR from [362,385,387,263,373,380] and [33,160,158,133,153,144], and MAR from [78,308,13,14], matching the training pipeline. It calibrates with 75 valid open-eye frames, rejects partial-eye calibration, and persists a versioned baseline. Observations are linearly resampled to the training cadence of 25 FPS before Savitzky-Golay smoothing, normalization and six temporal deltas form the 75x12 TFLite input. Inference runs every 5 resampled frames like the desktop pipeline. Head pose uses ML Kit Euler angles. ML Kit exposes 0..467 points but not refined iris 468..477, therefore Iris is neutralized instead of replaced with a noisy proxy. The corrected desktop guardrail raises the score after sustained negative EAR z-score instead of using the original reversed sign.
